explanation.headline: Tramadol hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list; Corvale East has 16.7 days on hand and Corvale General has 29 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include tramadol hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 303 tablets of the 50 mg presentation with a daily use of 18.1 tablets, providing 16.7 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 532 tablets of the same presentation with a daily use of 18.4 tablets, providing 29 days on hand.
The current label for the product names A-S Medication Solutions as the registered plant, which received a VAI classification on 2026-08-12.
That plant also received a Warning Letter on 2017-06-05 and multiple prior VAI inspections dating back to 2009.
The rule-based alternate manufacturer ranked first is Advagen Pharma Limited, which is not on FDA's shortage list and uses Rubicon Research Limited, last inspected NAI on 2024-03-08.
Buyers should verify current inventory against the days-on-hand figures and confirm Advagen Pharma Limited supply availability before placing orders.

memory.text: Decision on cisplatin: transfer cisplatin between Corvale hospitals weekly instead of buying grey-market stock. Rationale: Grey-market offers were 6 to 10 times contract price with unverifiable pedigree (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
